# Inventory notes (generated by scripts/inventory.py)

## Counting rules
- Scanned: repo (excluding .git), ORICO experiment-data (excluding dvc-cache, git bundle), and in-memory members of the 4 zip archives on ORICO (the repo copies of artifacts/*.zip are Git-LFS pointers, not zips). One raw row per directory holding rounds.jsonl and/or config.json.
- Identity: method/seed/backbone/K/planned rounds come from config.json (`method`, `hp.seed`, `cfg.model` or `n_params` 77904=bert / 395408=dagsnet, `clients`, `hp.rounds`, `case`); when config.json is absent they come from the path name. Legacy method name `mobihet_budget` is mapped to mobihet_l4 (single-backbone BERT/DAGSNet MobiHet L4); other `mobihet_*` methods (core, stats*, pair, rel, lite, compute) are probes.
- run_kind: smoke (sm_*, smoke*, K<5343 with <=3 rounds), centralized, compute-trace (compute-2026*/compute-detailed*), dropped-method (scaffold), probe (`probe` in name, MobiHet variants, K<5343 longer runs, l4-port, regress), pilot (`pilot`/`dbg-`), then production / production-duplicate / continuation-session.
- Logical run = (scenario, method, seed). Candidates = all non-smoke/pilot/probe FL sessions with rounds.jsonl for that key. Every session's rounds.jsonl is CUMULATIVE (a resumed Kaggle session re-emits rounds 1..N from the parent checkpoint chain), so sessions overlap on rounds 1..k; overlap is verified per round by a timing-free content signature.
- Canonical = session with the largest contiguous last round (ties: source matches results.csv `source` or round-metrics provenance sha256, then repo > ORICO > zip, then has config.json). Canonical rounds are exactly 1..R from that single session, so no round is counted twice. If no session were contiguous the rounds would be stitched (flag `canonical-stitched`).
- Other sessions: exact-duplicate (same rounds.jsonl sha256) or content-duplicate -> duplicate_of; prefix-session (earlier hop of the same chain, identical on overlap) -> continuation-session; DIVERGES (different content on overlapping rounds) -> independent re-run, listed, not used.
- rounds_completed = max round with a committed record in canonical rounds.jsonl; status complete if R >= expected round (results.csv `round`, i.e. 50, or 10 for CANPerFL), else partial.
- Mixed clients_per_backbone: from cfg.clients ids looked up in experiments/mixed-model-v1/caseN.csv (sha256 of the csv equals cfg.assignment_sha256 where verified). Sessions without config.json get the manifest counts flagged as assumed.
- results.csv expected cells: (scenario, method, seed) rows of each experiments/*/results.csv (all 'audited'). Centralized cells are excluded from missing_runs (comm_applicable=no): 15 cells.
